# polychat
multi-lingual decentralized p2p chat based on web RTC and Google Translate API

bower install
gsutil -m cp -r * gs://www.polychat.io
gsutil -m acl set -r public-read gs://www.polychat.io
gsutil web set -m index.html gs://www.polychat.io
